objectClass.primaryType: cut flower stem — double ruffled bloom (user id: carnation; reads as Eustoma/lisianthus)
objectClass.notes: Organic thin-shelled object, NOT a character. Hero shadow-caster: silhouette from every azimuth dominates; surface detail secondary.

reasoning: Three macro masses: stem (h 0→0.79), corolla head (h 0.80→1.0, 0.21 wide), leaf pair.
Corolla is ~18 overlapping curved petal shells in 3 whorls (5 outer flared, 6 middle, 7 inner crumpled) plus 5 sepals: repetition systems drive the silhouette.
Single front view hides the back half of the head and the leaf azimuth: occlusion risk 2.
Veins/pollen skipped per brief; ruffled margins kept because they change the outline.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Silhouette depends on petal whorl repetition and leaf placement; pivots base/midStem/head required for sway.

unknownsToResolveBeforeImplementation.resolution: continue radial whorls with seeded jitter; flare asymmetry mirrored at reduced amplitude
leaf pair treated as opposite, decussate-ish: both near the image plane, rotated ±15° in depth
S-curve given a depth component of ~50% of the lateral amplitude

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: undulating ruffled outer petal margins, ~5–7 waves per petal, amplitude ~6% of petal width
thin deeper-pink fringe (~#d99aa8) along petal edges
head flares wider to −x at the top-left (outer petal lean)
5 awl-shaped sepal tips curling outward/down beneath the head
shallow keel fold along leaf midrib, lighter midrib line
stem thickens slightly where leaves clasp (node)
outer petal edges read lighter: thin-shell translucency
stem darkens to olive at the cut base

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: Front silhouette matches the reference: head 0.21 wide × 0.20 tall atop a 0.79-high stem; leaf tips at (−0.09, 0.56) and (+0.10, 0.49).
From side, 3/4 and top, the head reads as a round cup of curved petal shells (never flat cards); outer whorl flares 35–50° from vertical.
Stem is a tapered tube with a gentle S-curve; leaves are curved lance blades clasping the stem.
Every mesh casts shadows; petals render double-sided; origin at stem base, default height 1.0.

featureGroups.name: Cup-shaped double corolla silhouette
qualityCriteria: head bbox 0.21w × 0.20h, wider than tall, flares wider to −x
outer whorl 5 petals flaring 35–50°, middle 6 upright, inner 7 crumpled
failureModes: petals are flat cutouts from the side
cup too tall or too narrow

featureGroups.name: Long tapered stem with gentle S-curve
failureModes: stem too thick or uniform cylinder

featureGroups.name: Opposite lanceolate leaf pair
qualityCriteria: length ~0.21, max width ~0.05 at 35% length, acuminate tips arcing up-out
failureModes: leaf roots float off the stem

featureGroups.name: Calyx cup with curled sepals
failureModes: no transition between stem and head

featureGroups.name: Petal gradient
qualityCriteria: base #e7b8b9 → edge #f2d8d7, picotee fringe #d99aa8, edge translucency

visualDeltaChecks: head width/height ratio and flare asymmetry
side/top views: cup depth and petal curvature (no flat cards)
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).

authoringInstruction: Fill observed object class, complexity reasoning, featureGroups, visualDeltaChecks, and unknowns before generating or implementing ObjectSculptSpec.
